# h12_fork_async

Report issues: W3, R1.

**Source.** Hand-made SimOxide corpus model (`corpus/h12_fork_async`, generated by refsim's `HandMade.java`). Licence: EPL-2.0 (SimOxide repository). `run.json` and `FEATURES.txt` are SimOxide metadata (`run.json` holds SimuLizar stop conditions; Slingshot uses the simulation time below).

## Model

A ForkAction with two asynchronous forked behaviours and no SynchronisationPoint.

## Run with stock Slingshot

Import the folder into an Eclipse workspace with the Slingshot nightly. Create a *Slingshot Simulation* run configuration:

- Allocation Model: `h12_fork_async.allocation`
- Usage Model: `h12_fork_async.usagemodel`
- Monitor Repository: `h12_fork_async.monitorrepository`
- Simulation tab: maximum simulation time **26 s**; EDP2, an in-memory repository.

The other model files are loaded through the references. Set the console log level to INFO to see the dispatched events and the handler errors (`An error occurred: …`).

The model draws random numbers. Stock Slingshot cannot be seeded, so times and values vary between runs; the effect described below does not depend on them.

## What to look for

- `IllegalStateException: ForkAction must have a synchronisation point!` (`SeffInterpreter.java:175`).
- No measurement row in the whole run.

## Expected

The asynchronous behaviours start detached and the caller continues at once (a fork without a SynchronisationPoint is valid PCM).

## Observed (reference runner)

`observed/` holds the outputs of the SimOxide reference runner, deterministic mode, `-seed 11 -simTime 26` (appendix of `../../REPORT.md`): `errors.txt`, `measurements.csv`, `projection-m.jsonl`, `summary.json`.
`errors.txt` lists the handler exceptions (`exception: message | first Slingshot frame`), one per disposed handler; `measurements.csv` the EDP2 rows (`measuring_point,metric,time,value`); `projection*.jsonl` the dispatched model-level events (users, calls, jobs, measurements, SPD events; `projection-m.jsonl` without passed elements and jobs).

Headless (optional, from `reference/slingshot/`):

```sh
./run.sh --stock -model upstream-report/reproductions/h12_fork_async -out /tmp/h12_fork_async -simTime 26 -seed 1
./run.sh         -model upstream-report/reproductions/h12_fork_async -out /tmp/h12_fork_async-det -simTime 26 -seed 11   # deterministic
```
